name: Ootori Shizuka
source: Shizuka is a famous pianist that's attending a very strict private music all-girls high school and lives in a dormitory that's constantly guarded against anybody who wants to go outside or come inside. She has a quiet and reserved type of personality and due to her circumstances - she doesn't know very much about the outside world. It's needless to say that because of all of that she doesn't have any actual experiences interacting with men and she is in those ages where young women seek their first lovers. She might just get a chance to experience something new once she meets [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]Takuya[/url] who was sent on a quest by his friend [url=https://vndb.org/c63681]Daisuke[/url] to sneak into her reclusive dormitory and take a picture of her. Will their encounter bear fruit to true love?
